text:
izzy_support: FYI — Vireo Labs activation failing for ~30% of trial users. Support ticket #12345. Error looks like quota/rate limit + unclear retry guidance. Escalating to CS for comms + next steps.

tara_cs: Can you paste the exact error & any logs you have? cc @sam_success_mgr

izzy_support: here's the snippet we see in the logs:
```
2024-11-08T14:02:11Z ERROR request failed status=429 msg=\"Rate limit exceeded\" customer_id=vireo-92 attempt=3
```
Also seeing bursts from a single API key — likely retry storm.

dev_ex: Looking at routing, their integration is hitting the /v1/generate batch endpoint with no backoff. Might be a client-side retry loop. I'll pull traces for the last 6 hours.

sam_success_mgr: I'll own the CS side. Proposed comms plan: 1) notify customer within 2h, 2) offer temporary quota bump while we fix, 3) provide immediate retry pattern + small code snippet, 4) update public docs. Who can authorize a bump?

izzy_support: Ops can do a manual bump for trials — I've requested a temp 2x quota for vireo-92, pending approval.

dev_ex: I approved the bump and applied it (confirmed). Opened INF-890 to add short-term throttling and circuit-breaker on our side (ETA ~48h). Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-890

sam_success_mgr: Draft outbound to customer (ready to send after you confirm bump):
"Hi Vireo team — we’ve identified the cause of the activation failures (excessive retries producing spikes). We’ve applied a temporary quota increase and rolled a fix to protect your requests while we implement durable throttling. Next steps: guidance + a 1:1 onboarding to walk through retry/backoff patterns. ETA for a permanent fix ~48 hours. Apologies for the disruption — we’ll follow up with status updates"

tara_cs: Add a renewal/health note: flag account for "onboarding risk"; if >3 activation failures persist after 72h, start renewal outreach. Also capture feedback so product can adjust default retry guidance in SDK.

sam_success_mgr: Noted — I'll set the onboarding-risk flag and create a renewal watch in Gainsight. I'll also schedule the 1:1. Will post an update in 6 hours.

infra-bot: Ticket #12345 moved to P1 by izzy_support. INF-890 created by dev_ex.

izzy_support: Closing loop on support side for now — ticket is P1 and we've done the manual bump. Ping me if you need any logs for the customer call. :thumbsup:
